svg.title: Chief information officer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as chief information officer, wearing a tailored jacket. Visible work cue: Two slim server modules connect by a cable to a separate data display. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face and round glasses.
